_why: Tokens that npm run lint:token-layer must not call dead, each with the reason. Two kinds only. `unreadable` is what the platform cannot take: the value has to be repeated literally at the call site, and the token stands beside it as the source of truth. `published` is a token this system offers outward on purpose, taken by nothing here — and it is the harder case to justify, because the owner's rule says a product using a token is not a reason to keep it (2026-09-02). A ladder step needs no entry: the check derives that from the family.

unreadable.--bp-sm: @media cannot read a custom property, so every media query repeats 30rem literally. lint:rules holds those literals to this scale, which is only possible because the token is here to be the scale.
unreadable.--bp-md: the same, 48rem — the tablet step, and the one the sidebar drawer switches on.
